title: Taiwan Wants to Know Why Indonesia Joined China in a Naval Exercise East of Taiwan
author: Brian Hioe
text:
This undated photo, released by China’s military, shows the Honghe, the frigate that took part in the passex with Indonesia on Aug. 12, 2026.
Credit: X/ China Military Bugle
In a rare moment of diplomatic friction, Taiwan has called on the Indonesian government to clarify joint naval exercises with China that took place in waters east of Taiwan. The exercise took place on the morning of August 12, between 6:30 a.m. and 9:30 a.m. As part of the naval exercise, the Indonesian Navy frigate KRI I Gusti Ngurah Rai and the Chinese People’s Liberation Army Navy’s Honghe, a guided-missile frigate under the Eastern Theater Command, practiced maritime maneuvers. The drill included practicing formation, maritime communications, as well as replenishment-at-sea, and concluded with a divergence ceremony.[...]
